description: This file contains Kotlin source code defining composable functions related to performance metrics and jank tracking in an Android application using Jetpack Compose. It includes functions for retrieving performance metric state, monitoring jank during scroll and other actions, and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: rememberMetricsStateHolder
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceMetricsState.Holder for the current view hierarchy and remembers it across recompositions.

methods.name: TrackJank
methods.description: Composable that launches a coroutine to report performance metrics, re-launching if any keys change.

methods.name: TrackDisposableJank
methods.description: Composable that performs a disposable effect to report performance metrics and clean up resources, re-launching if keys change.

methods.name: TrackScrollJank
methods.description: Tracks jank during scrollable content, updating the performance metrics state accordingly.
